The job market has officially turned into an obstacle course designed by LinkedIn lunatics.

Now companies are requiring three-minute videos just to apply. No video? Resume trashed. Because apparently if you won’t perform for a camera before you’re even hired, you clearly won’t “grind” when things get tough.

In this video we break down the absolute nonsense applicants are wading through right now. Mandatory video auditions. Vibe-based hiring logic. CEOs romanticizing six and seven day work weeks in Asia like it’s some kind of hustl
title: APPLYING FOR JOBS IS OFFICIALLY BROKEN!
